title: eludite.project.remove_reference input
description: Remove a project or assembly reference (brief 0081; Remove on a reference in the Dependencies node).

project.description: The project: its name as the Workspace window shows it, or the path of its project file (absolute, or relative to the solution folder).

reference.description: project kind: a project of the solution, by name or path. assembly kind: a .dll path (absolute or relative to the solution folder), or an assembly name (System.Xml).

kind.description: project or assembly. Default: project when reference names a project of the solution or ends in .csproj, .vbproj or .fsproj, else assembly.
